title: ValidationVerdict
description: Adversarial review verdict for a single finding. CANNOT emit new findings.

rationale.description: Why the finding stands or falls. Must engage with the evidence, not restate it.

alternative_explanation.description: If rejected: the benign explanation. If confirmed: any rival hypothesis you ruled out.

missing_preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold for the bug to fire (sanitization upstream, config flags, etc.).

suggested_test.description: Concrete test that would disambiguate — e.g. a curl command, a unit test stub.

cvss_vector.description: CVSS 3.1 base vector, e.g. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H. Required for a confirmed verdict; omit/empty for rejected or needs_more_info.

cvss_score.description: CVSS 3.1 base score (0.0-10.0), computed deterministically from cvss_vector by the pipeline — not emitted by the model.

cvss_rating.description: Qualitative CVSS band derived from cvss_score by the pipeline — not emitted by the model.

checked_lines.description: W3.2. The `file:line` or `file:start-end` locations you ACTUALLY opened to reach this verdict, including the ones that made you reject the finding. A verifier that confirms without citing the sanitizer it ruled out has not done the job this phase exists for, and until this field existed nothing could detect that. List what you read, not what you were given: the finding already carries its own location, so repeating it alone is not evidence of verification.

second_verifier_of.description: W3.3. Set when this record is the SECOND verdict on a finding whose structural probe returned `refuted`. Carries the finding_id. `refuted` is deterministic counter-evidence and one agent's paragraph should not overturn it, so a confirm against a refutation is re-run on a third model with both the finding and the refutation in hand, and both verdicts are kept.
